thread:
maria: midshift async check-in — quick status: kernel warmup tweaks, KV cache eviction tuning, and a tiny perf run. posting blockers below

sam: got it. what branch/PR are you on for the kernel warmup change?

maria: PR #4321 — changed default priming window from 128 -> 256 to reduce cold-start tail. small patch, added flag "--warmup-extend"

leo: saw that, left a couple of comments about slot accounting. need to ensure we don't double-count in microburst path.

maria: thanks, will address. question: does anyone have a repro for the p95 spike we saw on canary at 11:10?

taylor: I grabbed flamegraphs — looks like a hotspot in serialize_kv_batch when batch size hits 48. pushing a bench now with smaller packet sizes.

anya: FYI I ran a quick end-to-end bench using the script: ``./tools/bench --model=gptx-small --seq=1024 --concurrency=12 --batch-target=40`` result: p50 ~ 12ms, p95 ~ 220ms, p99 ~ 490ms. CPU side serialization is chewing time.

sam: can you paste the bench output? small snippet is fine — curious about kernel vs python overhead.

anya: pasted log: ``[bench] tokens=100k throughput=1.1k tok/s p50=12ms p95=220ms p99=490ms``

leo: hmm that throughput looks lower than expected vs previous runs. did you hit KV cache misses?

anya: cache hit ratio 78% for that run. I can re-run with forced priming to get ~98% hit and compare.

maria: re-running with priming would be great. also planning to add a small shared buffer pool to reduce malloc churn — I'll prototype after addressing review comments.

taylor: for the batcher, I suggested a microdelay of 0.6ms in the PR to let small requests coalesce. It reduced p50 by ~6% in local tests.

sam: microdelay is fine if we can keep SLO for latency-sensitive routes. maybe make it configurable per route?

maria: agreed. will add per-route override option. question for infra: any constraints on adding a 256MB arena for buffer pool on Dedicated nodes?

leo: infra says we have headroom on older pools, but new hardware reservations are tight. keep it optional with env var toggle.

anya: re-run results with priming: ``tokens=100k throughput=1.4k tok/s p50=10ms p95=160ms p99=330ms`` — hit ratio 96% and p95 improved a lot.

maria: that suggests warmup change helps. plan: push PR updates (address slot accounting + route override + buffer pool behind env var), then run canary with priming enabled.

sam: ping me for review once you push updates. I can run a short canary on the staging shard after merge.

leo: I'll prepare a small script to fake microburst traffic so we can validate p99 behavior: ``scripts/microburst.sh --burst-size=80 --interval=120s``

maria: awesome. blockers: need clarity on buffer pool API (I will sketch) and sam's manual canary window. other than that, on track.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: staging/canary -> 1700012300 if PR CI passes :rocket:

maria: cool. I'll push updates in ~45m and tag @sam. thanks all :thumbsup:

sam: thanks — will allocate 20m after CI to run that microburst harness

leo: leaving notes in the PR about the slot accounting tests I ran locally — should help review.

anya: I'll add the bench artifacts to the ticket. might try qemu runs for serialized path profiling later today.

maria: great. if anyone hits regressions after canary please drop notes here. signing off for coffee break. :coffee:
